what: Measure integrated loudness first, then apply the measured values linearly so the mix lands on target without pumping.
how: pass1: -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11:print_format=json -f null - ; pass2: loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11:measured_I=..:measured_TP=..:measured_LRA=..:measured_thresh=..:linear=true,aresample=48000. AAC adds ~0.5 dB overshoot so aim TP -1.5 to measure ~-1 dBTP.
params: YouTube/social -14 LUFS ±1, TP ≤ -1 dBTP; broadcast EBU R128 -23; podcast -16
when: حين يلزم ضبط علو الصوت النهائي على هدف ثابت لليوتيوب أو البودكاست دون تذبذب / when the final mix must land on a loudness target such as -14 LUFS accurately, without pumping

params: default downbeat every 4 beats when not measured

params: loudnorm I=−14 TP=−1.5 LRA=11 + alimiter limit 0.84 (≈ −1.5 dBFS) attack 3 release 60; mux I=−14 TP=−1 linear=true

Write our own script; numpy+ffmpeg exist here.

what: Logo pulses on bass, CTA glow on treble, background breathes with amplitude, sampled per frame from precomputed bands; no spectrum bars.

params: fft window 4096 @44.1kHz; 16 bands at 30fps; text/logo scale <= 1+0.04*bass (<=5%), glow <= 30% (treble*24px drop-shadow); backgrounds 10-30%
when: حين تريد شعارا ينبض مع الباص وزرا يتوهج مع الحدة وخلفية تتنفس مع الصوت دون أعمدة طيف / when a logo should pulse on bass, a CTA glow on treble and the background breathe with sound, without spectrum bars

name_ar: قائمة قطع تلقائية من المازورات وذروات الحركة
name_en: Auto edit list from bars and motion peaks
what: Find the song's bar lines, pick the busiest moments of the footage by measured motion, and lay one shot per bar (title card one bar, end card on the remainder); a sync check requires the picture to change within one frame of each sound onset.
how: Locally: numpy onset/tempo estimation on the music, ffmpeg scene/motion scores (select='gt(scene,x)' or frame-difference energy) on footage, write an EDL JSON, render; 9:16 version places the whole frame over a blurred fill rather than cropping action.
params: 1 shot per bar; sync tolerance 1 frame
when: حين تريد مونتاجا تلقائيا يضع لقطة لكل مازورة من أكثر لحظات الفيديو حركة مع فحص التزامن / when auto-building an edit with one shot per bar from the footage's busiest moments, with a sync check

what: Cut every shot on bar lines of the music: title card 1 bar, shots 1 bar each, end card on the remainder.
how: bar_s = beatsPerBar*60/bpm; shot boundaries at k*bar_s + offset; requires known BPM or detection.
when: عند تقطيع اللقطات على حدود المازورة: عنوان بمازورة ولقطة لكل مازورة وخاتمة على الباقي / when cutting every shot on the music's bar lines: title card one bar, one bar per shot, end card on the rest

what: Level SFX by max momentary loudness into tiers so a set sits in a mix without rebalancing.
how: Big -9/-10, actions -11/-14, frequent -15/-17, UI -15/-19 LUFS-M; or loudest-50ms classes ui -20, small -16, normal -12, big -9 dB; ceiling -1 dBFS.
when: حين تضبط مستويات المؤثرات الصوتية في طبقات (كبيرة، حركات، متكررة، واجهة) لتجلس في المزج / when levelling a set of SFX into loudness tiers (big, actions, frequent, UI) so they sit in the mix

what: Render a section three times back-to-back and keep the middle so reverb/echo tails are already in its head; or wrap tail onto start.
how: numpy concatenation; frequencies multiples of 1/loop length; check seam_ratio <1.5 (good <0.5).
when: عند صنع حلقة صوتية تتكرر بلا قفزة بحيث تكون ذيول الصدى موجودة في بدايتها / when making a seamless audio loop whose reverb and echo tails are already present at its head

when: عند جعل النصوص أو الأشكال تكبر مع الباص وتتوهج مع الترددات الحادة / when captions or shapes should scale with the bass and glow with the treble

what: Beat sheet -> cue/bar map from BPM -> EDL -> render shots -> assemble; overlays are pure functions of frame.
how: Bars 1-based; fx timing in beats; flash peak 0.35 soft fades; slow-mo never slows graphics.

what: Frequency bands drawn as bars, rings or glows driven by pre-analysed audio, a chart-like visualizer synced to the user's music or voice.
how: Pre-compute per-frame RMS and band energies from the audio (ffmpeg or WebAudio offline), store as JSON, read by frame in the page. Smooth with prev*s + raw*(1-s). Layout: horizontal bass-left treble-right, vertical bass-bottom, or circular starting at 12 o'clock clockwise. Bass drives scale/glow, treble drives shimmer, RMS drives background energy; animate only 2-3 properties; keep minimums above zero.
params: bands 4/8/16/32 (8 = basic spectrum, 16 default); smoothing 0.25 (0.1-0.2 snappy, 0.3-0.5 flowing)
when: حين يطلب المستخدم أعمدة طيف أو حلقات أو توهجا يتحرك مع موسيقاه أو صوته كمؤثر مرئي / when the user wants frequency bars, rings or glows animated to their music or voice as a visualizer

name_en: Code-synthesised chirp ticks on motion events
what: مؤثرات صغيرة تُكتب بمعادلة على موعد كل حدث بصري، فوق طنين منخفض خفيف، بلا ملفات صوت خارجية. / Short chirps written as a formula at each visual event over a faint low bed — no external audio files.
how: sr 24 kHz mono 16-bit. Bed: 0.009·sin(2π·160·t)·sin²(πt/D). For each event time a: z = t−a; add 0.075·e^(−50z)·sin(2π(320+190z)z) for 0 ≤ z < 0.14 s (a rising chirp that dies in ~100 ms). Event list = the same times that drive the picture (0.3, 1.0, 1.85, 2.7, 4.3, 5.35 s), so sound and motion share one clock. Clip to ±1, write WAV, mux AAC with -shortest. how: Owner script music_window.py (stdlib + ffmpeg; not vendored here): `music_window.py track --len 30 --after 60 --top 3 --fps 30`. It decodes to mono, builds 100 fps energy and onset curves (full band + below 120 Hz), estimates tempo by autocorrelation with a mild prior around 120 BPM, and scores windows: +8 for a breath-then-drop in the first quarter, +5 for a lift at 50–85 %, +4 for a final hit. A DROP needs the last 1.2 s to sit ≥ 3.5 dB under the level 4–1.5 s earlier and the next 0.5 s to rise ≥ 6 dB above that dip; a long breakdown therefore reads as a LIFT instead. `--sections a-b,c-d` prints mean level per section (does the build climb?). Ran here (V4) on an original 90 s 120 BPM test track: tempo 119.7 BPM (confidence 1.0); with a 1.2 s breath before the drop it found DROP +13.5 dB at 48.10 s and picked the window 46.9–76.9 s (drop 1.2 s in); with an 8 s breakdown it reported only a LIFT at 46.12 s. Accents of a pitch-swept synthetic kick were reported 70–150 ms late (the low band peaks after the attack): check with BEAT-X03. Status note: the code is owner material that is not vendored in this skill; the numbers above are from one run on the owner's copy on 2026-10-16 and cannot be re-run from here, so this is 📄 documented, not ✅.

what: قبل أي بيت حدد عنوانًا يُحفظ من أول سماع، ووعد اللازمة، وأداة الخطاف، ومنعطف الجسر؛ ثم اكتب أبياتًا تُغنّى بنَفَس. — Before any verse fix a title phrase memorable after one listen, the chorus promise, the hook device and the bridge turn; then write lines that can be sung on a breath.
when: كتابة أغنية أو جنغل أو دويتو، بالعربية أو غيرها — writing a song, jingle or duet in Arabic or any language.
how: Brief (infer silently, ask only high-impact gaps): the one sentence the listener keeps · language + dialect · narrator and addressee · emotional arc start → turn → end · genre/fusion · tempo/energy · vocal identity · duration/sections · must-include / forbidden phrases · intended use. Hook devices: repetition, contrast, question/answer, image, command, name/address, vowel phrase; one idea per hook. Mechanics: short clauses, natural stress, open vowels on sustained notes, clean consonant landings; concrete verses (object, place, gesture, weather); mix end rhyme, internal rhyme, assonance and an unrhymed release; each chorus repeat escalates; stable point of view; the bridge reveals, reframes or decides. Templates: pop Intro-V1-Pre-Ch-V2-Pre-Ch-Bridge-FinalCh-Outro; ballad without Pre; jingle Hook-Verse-Hook-Tag; duet as labelled call-and-response that unites in the final chorus.

how: One register unless code-switching is requested; light tashkeel only on ambiguous words; no elongation like «حبيييبي» (give vocal direction instead). Gulf/Saudi: consistent pronouns, vocatives and endings; Hijazi has its own flow, not generic Gulf; Egyptian: consistent negation, pronouns and verb forms, no sudden formal endings. Adaptation keeps emotional function, hook position and singability over literal wording. Never copy protected lyrics or melodies; abstract the traits.

what: رتّب وصف الأسلوب بترتيب ثابت وبكلمات ملموسة، واجعل حقل الاستبعاد للسلبيات الحقيقية فقط. — Order the Style description consistently with concrete words, and keep Exclude for true negatives only.

Exclude lists only unwanted genres, instruments, vocal traits or production qualities; never the same trait in Style and Exclude; never use Exclude to fix weak lyrics; change one slider or control at a time. how: Blocks in order: Title · Lyrics (markdown with [Section] tags) · Style · Exclude/Advanced; optionally one model/iteration note; never one giant block. PASS only if: the hook is identifiable; the chorus lifts above the verse; lines are singable at tempo; dialect and point of view are stable; imagery is specific; rhyme is natural; the arc changes pressure; Style and Lyrics agree; Exclude holds only true negatives; required phrases are present and forbidden ones absent; every field is copy-ready. Writing the prompt is not generating the song.
